apps.subtitle: Local AI · Hugging Face · Files import
apps.localizedDescription: Run MNN language models locally on your iPhone or iPad. Includes global Hugging Face search, public model downloads by repository/folder URL, and import of unpacked model folders or selected files. Models are downloaded separately. Supports MNN LLM exports; GGUF and safetensors need conversion. Community modified build, not an official Alibaba release.
